name: Suminomiya Aoi
source:
2nd year student.
Star Sign: Sagittarius
Likes: Japanese Food (Boiled/Stewed), School Store Bread
Dislikes: Bell Peppers

A quiet genius who lives in his own world.
Indifferent to others but once something grabs his attention, he devotes himself to it.
Studies calligraphy in his own "Aoi Room" in the school.
Childhood friend and rival of [url=/c53454]Ichijouji Teika[/url]. They fight over the number one spot but he doesn't care too much about it.
